title: Former Olympic skier Bode Miller arrested on misdemeanor drug charges
content:
Former Olympic skier Bode Miller was arrested on drug charges earlier this month in Fremont County, Idaho, court records show.

Miller was arrested on June 6 and charged with misdemeanor counts of possession of a controlled substance and possession of drug paraphernalia. He posted a $5,000 bond and pleaded not guilty to both charges, according to court records.

The Athletic reached out to Miller’s attorney for comment, but had not received a reply as of Tuesday evening.

His next court appearance is scheduled for July 29.

Miller, 48, won six medals at five Olympic Games, including gold in the super combined at the 2010 Vancouver Olympics.

He also owns 33 career World Cup victories, which is the most by any American man.

Miller retired from the sport in 2017 and was inducted into the U.S. Olympic and Paralympic Hall of Fame in 2025.
